changelog:
Fixed a crash that could hit while changing the text size: the custom font/typography feature rewrote CloudStream's Compose text styles during the frame that was about to be painted, which emptied Android's internal text layout cache and made the renderer abort with "ParagraphLayoutCache could not provide a Paragraph during the draw phase" (Safe mode on).
The typography pass now only *detects* that a text style has to be rebuilt during a frame and performs the rewrite right after it, so a fresh text measurement always happens before the next paint. Changing the system text size, display size or font scale no longer trips this.
Behaviour is unchanged otherwise: fonts, font scale, letter spacing and the glow on the CSM entry still apply, and turning the module off still restores CloudStream's original typography.
message: Dev build v868 - typography no longer empties Compose text caches inside a draw
